description: This file defines a PHP class Jjwg_AreasViewArea_Edit_Map that extends SugarView, responsible for rendering a web page with a Google Maps interface for editing and displaying geographical areas using polygons. It includes HTML, CSS, and JavaScript code for map rendering, polygon drawing, and coordinate management within a SugarCRM module.

classes.name: Jjwg_AreasViewArea_Edit_Map
classes.description: A class extending SugarView, responsible for rendering an HTML page with embedded Google Maps for area editing.
